note: E14 wired-path ratchet: known unwired modules (the backlog). New orphans not listed here fail the gate.

shrinkReview.verdict: SHRINK WITHHELD — 25 entries the gate reports as now-WIRED were verified individually and NONE is wired end-to-end. No entry removed.
shrinkReview.gateAdvisory: ratchet: 25 baseline module(s) are now WIRED - drop them from docs/build-provenance/wiring-baseline.json
why: All 25 become 'reachable' through exactly ONE importer: src/app/api/ops/agents/actions/route.ts. Verified: grep for importers of @/lib/agents/demo, @/lib/agents/dispatch and @/lib/sde outside those trees returns that single file and nothing else.

That route returns 403 to EVERY real authenticated session. src/lib/server/smartSession.ts's SessionAuthContext is {patient, fhirUser, scope} with no role field, so lib/authz/principal deriveRole() can only ever yield 'pa-reviewer' or 'member'; the route admits OPS_ROLES=['payer-ops','admin'] plus 'auditor'. The 200 path exists only under a test that mocks a role field the real context does not have. E14's own rule is 'a capability is DONE only when a production caller reaches it end-to-end' — an entry point that 403s for every caller does not satisfy it.

13 of the 25 are reachable only across 'export ... from' barrel re-export edges or type-only edges, which check-wiring.mjs counts as graph edges (its IMPORT_RE matches 'import type ... from' and 'export ... from'). Barrel-reachable is not called. Verified per module: agents/dispatch/dispatcher.ts, agents/dispatch/types.ts, agents/outreach/{index,outreachAgent,types}.ts, agents/pa/{index,paAgent,types}.ts, agents/referral/{index,referralAgent,types}.ts and sde/engine/explain.ts are REEXPORT-ONLY.

The E1 seam manifest names getAgentDemoActions() as the agentRuntime productionResolverRef, but the route's production branch calls runRealAgentDemo() instead — so the declared production resolver is not the one a production caller reaches.
shrinkReview.consequence: Removing these now would record 25 modules as wired on the strength of an unreachable route — the ratchet rotting in the direction that flatters the report, which is the failure E14 exists to prevent. The shrink is owed the moment the ops-route authz defect and the manifest resolverRef defect are fixed AND a test drives the 200 path from a real SessionAuthContext.
shrinkReview.reShrinkWhen: Re-run `npm run check:wiring`; for each entry the advisory names, confirm (a) a non-test importer chain from an entry point that a real session can actually reach, and (b) at least one value (non-type, non-barrel) edge. Then remove only the confirmed entries.
shrinkReview.caveat: `check-wiring.mjs --write-baseline` regenerates this file from the orphan scan alone and will DROP this key. Re-add it, or record the review in docs/build-provenance/coalition-log.md instead.

reaffirmed.what: W8 REMOVED these 25 entries on the strength of the gate's own advisory line, without reading the withheld verdict four lines above the list. Restored.
reaffirmed.whyRestored: Of the four blockers recorded above, exactly ONE has since cleared: SessionAuthContext now carries `role` (src/lib/server/smartSession.ts). Blocker 3 (13 of 25 reachable only across barrel re-export or type-only edges; check-wiring.mjs's IMPORT_RE still matches both) and blocker 4 (the E1 manifest names getAgentDemoActions() while the route's production branch calls runRealAgentDemo()) are both still true of the live tree. The reShrinkWhen precondition is not met.
reaffirmed.lesson: A gate advisory that says 'drop them from the baseline' is a measurement, not an authorisation. The ratchet exists to resist exactly the edit the advisory invites, and the recorded verdict is part of the baseline.
